note: City of Marshalltown Parks & Rec campground in Riverview Park on the north edge of town off Highway 14. Shaded lawn sites around one loop, with drive-through spaces for large rigs. The Iowa River runs about 100 m north behind a flood levee; a narrow lagoon lies across the park road east of the loop. Disc golf, dog park, courts, playgrounds and the Linn Creek and Iowa River's Edge trails in the park. --Claude
summary: Hookups (50A FHU), 70 sites (10 FHU + 60 electric; drive-throughs), facilities incl. wifi, season Apr 18-Oct 26 2026 and booking (online/phone/QR; >14 nights via office) confirmed from the city's page and brochure; fees $25/$35 unchanged. Not waterfront confirmed (levee between sites and the Iowa River). Pin ~170 m off, under the threshold. Note rewritten.
flags: WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed. The Iowa River (~60-90 m wide) is ~100 m north of the northern sites behind a continuous grassed flood levee, which also blocks any view. The 'LAGOON' on the city's map is a 15-20 m backwater channel across the park road from sites 5-8, which earns nothing (narrow, with the road between). Distances are imagery estimates.

SITES: the city's page contradicts itself. Its Features paragraph says 'Ten full hookup sites ...; 30 electrical hookup sites ...; 17 camper parking pads', while its Cost section and the brochure say 10 full hookup + 60 electric sites and 'There are no longer non-electric/tent only sites.' Count written as 70 from the Cost section.
PIN: stored 42.06350,-92.90600 is by the park building south of the loop, ~170 m from the loop's centre (~42.0646,-92.9070). Under the 250 m line; optional move.
HOST: the brochure lists site 1 as the host's full-hookup site in addition to the ten public full-hookup sites the Cost section names, so sewer rests on public sites.
